title: Radio station WOS and playing at the state prison
summary: His brother built a crystal set to hear the campus station WOS. The band also played at the state prison.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: One of the things I think you might like there was -- I liked it. We had a station called Watch our State, WOS, and my brother made a little, I don't know if you've ever seen one, crystal set and we'd broadcast this 125 miles. And every- body got their earphones and ... listened.
